g.text: Count the full cost of accepted work
A cheaper response can create a more expensive completed job.
All attempts + tools + selection + human review + rework + operation
Include the work people still perform
Record inference, data, tool calls, retries, candidateselection, review, rework and operational support.Failed and abandoned attempts still incur cost.
A lower model bill can be offset by corrections.Compare equivalent tasks at the same acceptedquality and critical limits.
Optiver’s program describes task-certified modelrouting. Quality must qualify before price optimization;certification on one workload does not generalize.
Predeclare eligibility, acceptance and exclusions.Report accepted-task rate alongside unit cost sonarrowing the task population cannot hide failures.
Sources: Contour notes; Optiver program context. Full-cost stack is our proposal; no savings or optimal routing policy is asserted.
